title: Equitas SFB to apply for universal bank licence in 2027
summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank is poised to apply for a universal bank license in 2027, following a leadership transition that has delayed the process. The board plans to recommend candidates for the MD and CEO roles by December 21. With all necessary criteria met, the bank aims to bolster its loan portfolio, emphasizing affordable housing and gold loans.

title: Bombay HC quashes ICICI board approval to prosecute Chanda Kochhar
summary: In a significant verdict, the Bombay High Court has dismissed any attempts to prosecute Chanda Kochhar, former CEO of ICICI Bank, emphasizing that only the Reserve Bank of India holds the authority to sanction such actions. Kochhar faces allegations surrounding a ₹300 crore loan to the Videocon Group, with accusations of a quid pro quo involving her spouse.

title: Sebi has no plans to extend trading hours for market: Tuhin Kanta Pandey
summary: Securities and Exchange Board of India Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated on Wednesday that market trading hours will not be extended. This decision comes in light of Nasdaq's announcement to expand US equity trading hours. Pandey highlighted concerns regarding cybersecurity if markets operate 24x7. He also noted no firm decision has been made regarding the MTF framework review.

title: Goldman Sachs upgrades India to overweight, sees Nifty at 28,500
summary: Goldman Sachs has upgraded India's investment outlook to overweight, targeting a Nifty level of 28,500 by the end of 2027. The brokerage cites expected earnings growth recovery and resilient domestic demand as key factors. It notes that foreign investor positioning is at a decade-low, presenting India as an attractive opportunity. Additionally, recent foreign flows into Indian equities suggest a recovery trend.

title: Titan, Kalyan Jewellers slide as gold heads for worst year since 2013
summary: Shares of companies like Titan and Kalyan Jewellers have taken a steep dive as gold prices plummet. Analysts predict that gold may face its worst annual decline in 13 years, dampening investor morale. This downturn is attributed to rising US interest rates and a strengthening dollar, creating uncertainty for jewelers and financiers alike.

summary: On Wednesday, Indian equity benchmarks experienced a downturn as profit-taking weighed on market sentiment. Additionally, National Aluminium Company and LT Foods entered into major partnerships, with other firms announcing developments that could influence their stock trajectory.

title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
summary: Indian equity benchmarks fell on Wednesday amid weak global risk appetite and concerns over margin-trading rules. Nifty 50 declined by 159 points while BSE Sensex dropped 500 points at the close. The Consumer durables sector performed poorly, while defensive sectors like pharma and healthcare remained stable. Foreign portfolio investors made net purchases, contrasting with domestic institutional investors who sold shares.

title: Smallcap earnings boom strengthens investment case despite valuation concerns
summary: Investors are encouraged to consider mid-cap and small-cap stocks even as large-cap stocks gain attention. Recent earnings reports show strong profit growth in small companies, which supports their investment case. Although profit margins have declined for both small caps and mid caps, earnings growth remains promising. Analysts urge a selective investment approach due to margins pressures and elevated valuations. Overall, mid-cap and small-cap segments should be included in investor portfolios.

title: Stock Radar: Kalyan Jewellers stock breaks out from inverted head & shoulder pattern to hit fresh 52-week high; time to buy?
summary: Kalyan Jewellers Ltd has recently broken out from an inverted head and shoulder pattern in November 2026. Experts suggest short-term traders may buy the stock for a target above 800 levels soon. The stock found strong support above 300 levels before rebounding, indicating a potential bullish reversal. Current momentum indicators show a positive outlook with sustained strength in price structure.

title: Gold loan firms seek RBI clarity on selling stressed loans to ARCs to help borrowers reclaim pledged jewellery
summary: Gold loan companies are urging the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to clarify rules allowing lenders to sell stressed gold loans to asset reconstruction companies (ARCs). They say the mechanism could give borrowers facing temporary repayment difficulties more time to repay and reclaim pledged jewellery instead of losing it through auctions.

title: Small loan defaults on the rise, lenders tighten credit checks
summary: Housing finance companies and NBFCs are tightening lending checks and cutting exposure to small-ticket loans of ₹7-10 lakh after a rise in repayment defaults among lower-income borrowers.
